arcane-pulse.summary: Chosen creatures within 10 ft of you make a CON save or take 1d8 Force and lose 10 ft of Speed until your next turn ends.

wrath.summary: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 Lightning, and the target's Speed drops by 10 ft until your next turn ends.

azure-strike.summary: Up to two targets no more than 30 ft apart: a ranged spell attack against each deals 2d6 Force and cuts its Speed by 10 ft until its next turn ends.

chains-of-ice.summary: A creature you can see makes a DEX save: on a failure 1d10 Cold and its Speed is halved until its next turn ends; on a success half damage.

consume-soul.summary: A creature makes a CON save or takes 4d4 Force, and you get Temp HP equal to half of it; half damage and no Temp HP on a success.

death-grip.summary: A creature you can see makes a STR save or is yanked in a straight line to the closest free space within 5 ft of you.

ebon-might.summary: Chosen creatures within 10 ft of you add 1d4 Force to each attack roll that hits until the end of your next turn.

entropic-embrace.summary: Triggered by rolling doubles on a D20 Test with Advantage or Disadvantage. For 1 minute you auto-succeed on Concentration saves, your space is Lightly Obscured, and once per turn you add 1d4 Necrotic to damage you deal or 1d4 to healing you give.
entropic-embrace.higherLevel: +1d4 to the extra damage or healing per slot level above 1.

fel-rush.summary: This turn you gain +30 ft Speed and provoke no Opportunity Attacks; each creature or unattended object you pass within 5 ft of makes a DEX save (once per turn) for 2d6 Fire, half on a success.

freezing-trap.summary: Plant an invisible trap at a point; the first creature to come within 5 ft sets it off and makes a CON save or is Restrained for 1 minute. Any damage frees it, and the spell ends once triggered.

frost-nova.summary: Chosen creatures within 15 ft of you make a CON save: on a failure 2d6 Cold and Restrained until the end of your next turn; half damage on a success.

infernal-strike.summary: Leap up to 30 ft without provoking Opportunity Attacks; creatures within 10 ft of where you land make a DEX save or take 2d6 Fire and have Disadvantage attacking anyone but you until your next turn starts (half damage only on a success).

living-flame.summary: Pick one per target: it heals 2d6 HP, or you make a ranged attack that deals 2d8 Fire on a hit.
living-flame.higherLevel: One extra target per two slot levels above 1 (up to five with a level 9 slot), each with its own choice.

moonfire.summary: A creature makes a DEX save or takes 2d8 Radiant, glows with 10-ft Dim Light and can't be Invisible, then takes 1d8 Radiant more at the end of its next turn; on a success it takes half the first hit only.
moonfire.higherLevel: +1d8 to both the first and the later damage per slot level above 1.

rune-strike.summary: Right after you hit with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, the target takes +2d8 Necrotic (+1d8 more against a Celestial).

scourge-strike.summary: Right after you hit with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, the target takes +2d6 Necrotic and makes a CON save or is Poisoned for up to 1 minute, saving again at the end of each of its turns.

shadow-word-pain.summary: A creature makes a WIS save or takes 1d10 + your spellcasting modifier Psychic and is cursed (half damage, no curse on a success). The cursed target takes 1d10 Psychic as each of its turns starts and saves again as each ends, for up to 1 minute.
shadow-word-pain.higherLevel: +1d10 to the first hit per slot level above 1.

throw-glaive.summary: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 Slashing + 1d8 Fire, and on a hit the glaive bounces to another target within 30 ft for a fresh attack.
throw-glaive.higherLevel: +1d8 Fire per slot level above 1; it can bounce as many times as the slot's level, never hitting the same creature twice.

vampiric-blood.summary: While you concentrate (up to 1 minute), your HP maximum rises by 10 and any healing you receive gives 1d6 HP more.
vampiric-blood.higherLevel: +1d6 to the extra healing per slot level above 1.

consecration.summary: A 15-ft Emanation around you deals 1d8 Radiant to chosen creatures that start their turn in it and is Difficult Terrain for Fiends and Undead, while you concentrate.

curse-of-agony.summary: A creature makes a CON save each time (now and at the end of each of its turns), taking the curse's damage, starting at 1d4 Psychic. On a failure the die grows one size, up to 1d12; on a success it takes the damage and the curse ends.

death-and-decay.summary: Creatures in a 20-ft-radius Sphere make a WIS save or take 2d6 Necrotic and are cursed until your next turn ends (half damage, no curse on a success). Your attack rolls that damage a cursed target add 1d6 Necrotic.

dream-breath.summary: Chosen creatures in a 15-ft Cone regain 2d6 HP.

eruption.summary: Creatures in a 20-ft-radius Sphere make a DEX save for 3d8 Fire, half on a success; the area is Difficult Terrain until your next turn ends.

eye-beam.summary: On casting and as a Magic action on later turns while you concentrate, creatures in a 15-ft Cone make a DEX save for 3d6 Force, half on a success.

feral-prowl.summary: Take a Wild Shape form without spending a use, and stay Invisible for up to 1 minute until you attack, deal damage, cast a spell or change back.

fiery-brand.summary: A creature makes a WIS save or takes 3d10 Fire and is cursed, giving you Resistance to all its damage; half damage and no curse on a success. It saves again at the end of each of its turns to end it.

frostscythe.summary: Creatures in a 20-ft Cone make a CON save: on a failure 3d8 Cold and -10 ft Speed for 1 minute; half damage on a success.

roar-of-ursoc.summary: Take a Wild Shape form without spending a use; until your next turn starts, creatures starting their turn within 5 ft of you have Disadvantage attacking anyone but you.

sigil-of-flame.summary: A creature you can see makes a CON save for 2d8 Fire, half on a success, and then gives off heat in a 10-ft Emanation: at the start of its next turn it and everyone in that area make a CON save or take 1d8 Fire.
sigil-of-flame.higherLevel: +1d8 to both the first and the later damage per slot level above 2.

blistering-scales.summary: A willing creature gets five explosive scales and +1 AC while you concentrate; each melee hit against it pops a scale for 1d8 Fire to the attacker, and the spell ends when none remain.
blistering-scales.higherLevel: One more scale per slot level above 3.

demon-spikes.summary: For 1 minute you have +2 AC, and a creature within 5 ft that hits you with a melee attack takes 10 Piercing.

emerald-blossom.summary: A spectral bulb grows in a free space; at the end of each of your turns, chosen allies within 10 ft of it regain 5 HP. It fades after healing 20 HP in total, or when your Concentration ends.
emerald-blossom.higherLevel: +5 to the bulb's total healing per slot level above 3.

flurry.summary: Three ice shards, each a ranged spell attack at the same or different targets: 3d6 Cold on a hit, and a Critical Hit leaves the target Restrained until your next turn ends.
flurry.higherLevel: One more shard per slot level above 3.

guided-prayer.summary: Heal 8d4 + your spellcasting modifier and gain Advantage on your next attack roll before the end of your next turn.

hand-of-guldan.summary: Creatures in a 20-ft-radius Sphere make a DEX save for 2d8 Fire + 2d8 Necrotic, half on a success. While you concentrate, a creature entering or ending its turn there saves again (once per turn) for 1d8 Fire + 1d8 Necrotic, half on a success.

leeching-strike.summary: Right after you hit with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, the target takes +3d8 Necrotic and you heal 3d4 HP.
leeching-strike.higherLevel: +1d8 damage and +1d4 healing per slot level above 3.

metamorphosis.summary: For 1 minute pick one form: Devourer (1s and 2s on Force damage dice count as 3), Havoc (melee weapon hits add 1d6 Fire) or Vengeance (+2 AC and +5 to both current and maximum HP).

prayer-of-mending.summary: A willing creature carries a ward for 1 minute; when it next takes damage it heals 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier, then the ward leaps to another ally within 30 ft. Ends after five heals or when no ally is in reach.
prayer-of-mending.higherLevel: One more heal per slot level above 3.

rain-of-fire.summary: A 20-ft-radius, 40-ft-high Cylinder: creatures in it, entering it, ending a turn in it or overtaken by it make a DEX save (once per turn) for 3d8 Fire, half on a success. A Magic action moves it 60 ft, and you have Advantage on spell attacks against creatures inside, adding 1d6 Necrotic on a hit.

regrowth.summary: A creature you can see heals 3d8 HP, then 1d8 more at the start of each of your turns while you concentrate, ending once it has healed 24 HP or more.

remorseless-winter.summary: Chosen creatures within 30 ft of you make a CON save for 6d6 Cold, half on a success; either way their Speed is 10 ft until the end of their next turn.

serpent-sting.summary: Right after you hit a creature with a weapon, it takes +4d6 Poison and is Poisoned for up to 1 minute; at the end of each of its turns it makes a CON save, taking 2d6 Poison on a failure and ending the spell on a success.

soul-reap.summary: Ranged spell attack that ignores Half and Three-Quarters Cover: 6d6 Force on a hit. Each 6 rolled adds another d6, up to your spellcasting modifier in extra dice.

breath-of-eons.summary: While you concentrate you gain a 60-ft Fly Speed with hover and your movement provokes no Opportunity Attacks; moving within 5 ft of a creature can curse it (once per turn) so the next damage it takes adds 1d10 Force.

chaos-nova.summary: Chosen creatures within 20 ft of you take 2d6 Force and make a WIS save or are Stunned until the end of your next turn.

collapsing-star.summary: Chosen creatures in a 20-ft-radius Sphere make a CON save for 4d12 Force, half on a success.

divine-shield.summary: When you take damage, become immune to all damage (the trigger included) until your next turn starts; meanwhile your Speed can't be lowered and nothing can move you against your will.

emberstorm.summary: Creatures in a 20-ft-radius Sphere make a CON save for 6d8 Fire, half on a success. Creatures and unattended flammable objects there catch fire and take 1d8 Fire as each of their turns begins.

holy-nova.summary: In a 30-ft Emanation, chosen creatures make a CON save for 5d6 Radiant (half on a success) and every other creature heals 3d6 HP.
holy-nova.higherLevel: +1d6 damage and +1d6 healing per slot level above 4.

psychic-horror.summary: A creature makes a WIS save or takes 2d10 Psychic and is Frightened for 1 minute (Stunned too until the end of your next turn), saving again at the end of each of its turns; half damage only on a success.

starfall.summary: Creatures in a 30-ft-radius, 40-ft-high Cylinder make a DEX save for 7d8 Radiant, half on a success. Until your next turn starts, a creature entering it or ending its turn there takes Radiant equal to your Druid level, once per turn.

time-dilation.summary: When you or a creature you can see within 60 ft takes damage, cut that damage by 4d8; the target then loses 1d8 HP at the end of each of its turns until it has lost a separately rolled 4d8.

upheaval.summary: Creatures in a 20-ft-radius, 10-ft-tall Cylinder make a DEX save: on a failure 1d12 Bludgeoning + 3d8 Fire and they're thrown to the top and fall; half damage only on a success. The ground is Difficult Terrain until your next turn ends.

bonestorm.summary: You heal 4d6 HP, and creatures within 10 ft of you make a CON save for 4d8 Necrotic, half on a success.

dream-flight.summary: While you concentrate you gain a 60-ft Fly Speed with hover and your movement provokes no Opportunity Attacks; moving within 5 ft of a creature can heal it 5d4 HP, once per turn per creature.

explosive-trap.summary: Plant an invisible trap at a point; the first creature within 5 ft sets it off, and creatures in a 20-ft-radius Sphere make a DEX save or take 8d6 Fire and, if Huge or smaller, are pushed 20 ft away.

innervate.summary: A creature within 30 ft gets a level 4 spell slot for its prepared spells, lost once used or at its next Long Rest; you also regain one Wild Shape use.

rescue.summary: Teleport to a free space you can see within 120 ft, bringing one willing creature within 60 ft of your starting point to a space within 5 ft of you.

shattering-star.summary: Ranged spell attack: 10d8 Force, and the target has -2 AC until your next turn starts.

sigil-of-chains.summary: Creatures in a 20-ft-radius Sphere make a DEX save: on a failure 5d6 Force, pulled up to 10 ft toward the center and Restrained until your next turn ends; on a success half damage and -10 ft Speed for that time.

void-eruption.summary: Creatures in a 20-ft-radius Sphere make a CON save for 5d6 Necrotic, half on a success. While you concentrate, you're Invisible in Dim Light or Darkness and can fire a Bonus Action ranged spell attack within 60 ft for 2d6 + your spellcasting modifier Necrotic.

azure-sweep.summary: Chosen creatures within 30 ft of you make a CON save: on a failure 7d8 Force and -20 ft Speed for 1 minute; half damage only on a success.

combustion.summary: For 1 minute you blaze with 20-ft Bright Light (plus 10 ft Dim), are immune to Fire and have Advantage on spell attacks; at the end of each of your turns, chosen creatures within 5 ft take 3d8 Fire.

tranquility.summary: While you concentrate, chosen creatures within 60 ft resist Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing, and as a Bonus Action you can heal each ally there 2d8 + your spellcasting modifier.

lay-waste.summary: Creatures in a 120-ft-long, 10-ft-wide Line make a DEX save for 12d6 Fire, half on a success; then you teleport to a free space within 5 ft of the Line's far end.

tree-of-life.summary: For 1 minute you become a Large tree: Speed 10 ft (can't be lowered, Difficult Terrain costs nothing extra), +2 AC, 10 Temp HP, immune to Paralyzed, Restrained and forced shape-shifting. Your slot healing spells heal +1d8, and your Druid spells get +1 save DC and Advantage on attack rolls.

apotheosis.summary: For 1 minute you gain a 90-ft Fly Speed and Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Radiant and Slashing; spells you cast with a slot that heal or deal Radiant work as if cast 2 slot levels higher (max 9).

mass-polymorph.summary: Any creatures you pick within 30 ft make a WIS save or turn into the same CR 0 Beast while you concentrate (up to 1 hour); only Beasts, Giants, Humanoids and Monstrosities can fail. Each gains Temp HP equal to the Beast's HP and reverts when those run out; it keeps its HP, mind and type but can't speak, cast or use its gear.
